Definition: from G3551 and G1320; an expounder of the (Jewish) law, i.e. a Rabbi:--doctor (teacher) of the law.
BiblicalUsage: A teacher of the law is a doctor of the law, and they sit in every scene where Jesus heals and where the apostles are judged. The doctors sit by while the power of the Lord heals, Gamaliel the doctor stands in the council and counsels patience with the apostles, and Paul warns of men who desire to be teachers of the law and understand neither what they say nor what they affirm.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Gamaliel is the exception that proves the rule: most doctors of the law sat to judge, and one stood to say, leave them alone. The men who desired to be teachers of the law understood neither what they said nor what they affirmed.
